title: How Horology works
subtitle: One Pipeline item, start to finish

cards.title: 1. You pick the work
cards.text: In Pipeline Master, set Agent status to Plan (needs scoping) or Ready (run it). Choose Agent type and Run location.

cards.title: 2a. Plan → Planner
cards.text: Rewrites Next step as a sharper question or numbered steps, then sets it back to No action. You review and set Ready.

cards.title: 2b. Ready → Supervisor
cards.text: You ask a Claude Code or Codex session to run the Ready items. It claims each one and starts one session per item.

cards.title: 3. Specialists do the work
cards.text: Research, technical assessment, security, GTM, marketing, content. The supervisor checks the results, then finishes the run.

cards.title: 4. Results land where you see them
cards.text: Drive documents, Document Index rows and a proposed decision. The item moves to Awaiting decision.

cards.title: 5. Sync job records what happened
cards.text: No AI. Copies the sheets into Neon, notes every change, links outputs to the run, and checks moves against workflow.yaml.

cards.title: 6. Daily digest reports back
cards.text: A Google Doc: counts, what finished, what's waiting on you, and anything that looks wrong.

cards.title: 7. You decide
cards.text: Accept, rework, park or reject in the Decision Register. Rework makes the item Ready again.
